Attacks

  • Phase 1
    • 1 marked strike on the ground near you every 2.4s (18 damage)
    • At range: 4 marked strikes on the ground near you every 3.4s (18 damage)
    • Up close: Area slam around itself every 4.2s (20 damage)
    • Up close: Ring of 8 projectiles every 3.8s (18 damage)
    • Volley of 3 projectiles aimed at you, with aim lines before it fires, every 5s (18 damage), if you keep away
    • Up close: Area slam around itself every 4.6s (20 damage), on Nightmare only
  • Phase 2 (under 66% HP)
    • 1 marked strike on the ground near you every 2.4s (18 damage)
    • Shuts you in a circle of flames or rocks, every 11s (14 damage)
    • At range: 3 parallel lances across the screen, the gaps between them safe, every 6.5s (18 damage)
    • Up close: Area slam around itself every 4.2s (20 damage)
    • Volley of 3 projectiles aimed at you, with aim lines before it fires, every 5s (18 damage), if you keep away
    • At range: 3 marked strikes along your path, from where you stand to where you're heading, every 3.6s (18 damage), under 50% HP
    • Ultimate Stone Edge, every 18s: 9 marked strikes on the ground near you every 18s (18 damage); 9 marked strikes on the ground near you every 18s (18 damage)
  • Phase 3 (under 33% HP)
    • 1 marked strike on the ground near you every 2.4s (18 damage)
    • Shuts you in a circle of flames or rocks, every 12s (14 damage)
    • At range: 4 marked strikes on the ground near you every 3.4s (18 damage)
    • Up close: Area slam around itself every 4.2s (20 damage)
    • Up close: Ring of 8 projectiles every 3.8s (18 damage)
    • Up close: Area slam around itself every 4.6s (20 damage), on Nightmare only

  • Only on Halloween Night 2026: in a haunted run, the Nightmare rift can take a rift's place, from 4:00 (optional)

Attacks

  • Phase 1
    • 1 marked strike on the ground near you every 2.6s (11 damage)
    • Teleports and lands on a marked circle, every 6.5s (16 damage)
    • Ring of 12 projectiles every 4.8s (13 damage)
    • 3 marked strikes along your path, from where you stand to where you're heading, every 5.2s (13 damage)
    • Calls helpers every 13s
    • Volley of 3 projectiles aimed at you, with aim lines before it fires, every 6s (13 damage), on Hard and Nightmare
    • Ultimate Dark Pulse, every 24s: Ring of 18 projectiles every 24s (15 damage); Ring of 18 projectiles every 24s (15 damage); Ring of 22 projectiles every 24s (15 damage)
  • Phase 2 (under 66% HP)
    • 1 marked strike on the ground near you every 3s (11 damage)
    • Volley of 3 projectiles aimed at you, with aim lines before it fires, every 4.2s (8 damage)
    • Ring of 10 projectiles every 6.5s (8 damage)
    • Area slam around itself every 5.5s (16 damage)
    • Teleports and lands on a marked circle, every 9s (14 damage)
    • 3 marked strikes along your path, from where you stand to where you're heading, every 5s (13 damage), on Hard and Nightmare
    • Ultimate Hypnosis, every 20s: Ring of 16 projectiles closing on you, with one way out, every 20s (8 damage); Ring of 18 projectiles closing on you, with one way out, every 20s (8 damage)
  • Phase 3 (under 33% HP)
    • 1 marked strike on the ground near you every 2.6s (11 damage)
    • Volley of 4 projectiles aimed at you, with aim lines before it fires, every 4.6s (8 damage)
    • 3 copies streak down a marked lane through where you stand, one after another, every 7s (15 damage)
    • Teleports and lands on a marked circle, every 7.5s (17 damage)
    • Ring of 14 projectiles every 5s (13 damage)
    • Ultimate Dark Void, every 22s: A blast over everything (24 damage), except in the marked shelters; Ring of 20 projectiles every 22s (15 damage)

Legend Mode

  • Event legend: beat it 2 times in the Nightmare rift during Halloween Night 2026 (October 24 to November 2) and it's playable in Legend Mode for good. It doesn't count toward Arceus.
  • Innate (always on): Bad Dreams
  • Starts with Dark Void Dark

★ Beating a shiny one on the catching win, or after, unlocks its shiny.

★ Can show up shiny in 1 of 8 rifts: it pays double ₽ plus another Poké Ball.
